projects.name: Woodbridge Corporate Park Warehouse Expansion
projects.owner: Stock Families / Panattoni Development. Industrial Realty Group (IRG)
projects.description: 1.03 million SF industrial warehouse proposed on the former Wild Waves Theme Park site in Federal Way, leased to Panattoni Development. Features dock-high loading on east and west sides. 971,390 SF total expansion across 3 warehouse properties with office space at Woodbridge Corporate Park (former Weyerhaeuser campus) in Federal Way. Public land use hearing held June 8, 2026.
